plainTranslation: A's mind meets B's love and values. The opposition pulls them into push-and-pull.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking press against your affections, tastes, and sense of worth. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
tension:
The challenge is that affection does not always arrive in a recognizable form. One person may think they are showing care, while the other does not feel cared for at all. What one person sees as thoughtful may feel distant to the other. What feels sincere may feel awkward. What seems obvious may not register at all.

Both people can end up feeling unseen. Each may be trying to connect in a genuine way, but what they offer is not what the other person needs. Even when there is care between you, it can be difficult to feel fully reached or understood.
advice: The more clearly you learn how each of you gives and receives affection, the easier it becomes to recognize the care that is already there.
summaryShort: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking press against your affections, tastes, and sense of worth.
